title: Collection
description: A versioned set of entries of one type, the unit of sync with the future API.

version.description: Bumped by hand whenever the content changes.

CoverMaterial.description:
Cover material at a given thickness (book p. 182). Combinations with 0 HP
(thin drywall) are not cover and are not stored.

code.description:
Stable readable code, unique per material and thickness (e.g.
`metal_thick`); scenes refer to presets by it.

name.description: Material name in the content language.

uuid.description: Identity of the record, the same in every language.

Source.description: Where a value comes from in the rulebook.

page.description: Printed page number (PDF page minus one).
